name: Pure Coordination Game
summary: Two-player simultaneous game where both players earn highest payoff by coordinating on the same preferred option.
rules_text: Two players simultaneously choose one of two technologies, Good or Bad. Choices are revealed together. If both choose Good, each gets 5. If both choose Bad, each gets 3. If they choose different technologies, each gets 0. Both players prefer Good-Good over Bad-Bad, but any mismatch is worst for both. The game is played for one round and payoffs are awarded as described. No communication is allowed before choosing.
rating_reason: Classic pure coordination 2x2 simultaneous game, payoff matrix
